comparables.description: Indonesian mature oil palm with mill access

methodology:
PT Sawit Sumbermas Sarana is a Central-Kalimantan-focused operator with 23 oil palm estates + 8 mills (540 TPH capacity). Total managed area ~116K hectares; planted 81.5K hectares (~69K nucleus + 12K plasma).

3-row breakdown:
- Nucleus estates (171K acres / ~69K ha planted): SSMS-owned mature plantations with mill access
- Plasma partnerships (30K acres / ~12K ha): smallholder partnership area where SSMS owns mills + processing rights but not land
- Unplanted concession reserves (~71K acres / ~34K ha): future development area at concession-stage discount

The 81K planted vs 116K total disparity is typical for Indonesian palm operators where concession areas exceed actual planted area. The differential is captured by separating nucleus from concession reserves at meaningfully different per-acre values.
